core_meaning.primary_meaning: Oguz is a Turkish-origin name meaning “Oghuz (Turkish tribal name)”.
core_meaning.literal_meaning: The name is the Turkish word itself, used unchanged as a given name rather than a derived or diminutive form.
core_meaning.meaning_explanation: Oguz corresponds to the Turkish form أُوغُوز (Turkish Oğuz (tribal name)). Its core sense is oguz; oghuz (turkish tribal name). Oguz is Turkish Oğuz, the name of a major Turkic tribal confederation. It is used as a male given name.

persian.name: اوغوز
persian.long_meaning: Oguz (اوغوز) نامی برگرفته از زبان ترکی است و معنای اصلی آن اوغوز، قبیله ترک است. این نام در جوامع مسلمان به کار می‌رود و کاربرد آن بسته به بافت زبانی متفاوت است.
